column1: # iOS's MEASURED answers (macOS Foundation DateFormatter, en_US_POSIX, non-lenient; 2026-10-02).
#  dateonly  = yyyy-MM-dd in the device zone (FormStepView.dateRange)
#  dateonly_lmt = a dateonly row before the zone had standard time: iOS's tz data applies the zone's local mean
#                 time (Los Angeles -7:52:58), the JVM's does not, so Android is that many minutes off (< 1 h);
#                 the reader's answer (accepted, which calendar day) is the same.
